blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—PAREF Springdale School (PSS) Titans head coach Jax Bautista didn’t expect two of his players to break into the top five of the individual rankings in their rookie season in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation Inc. (Cesafi). But with Anton Gratones leading the high school rankings and teammate Riche Sarmiento II occupying fourth place, Bautista could not hide his pride in the two young standouts who are making an impression in Cesafi Season 26. Based on the individual statistics released by Stats Central after the first half of the season, Gratones emerged as the top-ranked high school player, while […]...
